prompt:
THE PERSON IN ALL THREE PANELS IS A WOMAN IN HER FORTIES with SHORT CURLY DARK HAIR STREAKED WITH GREY, wearing a plain RUST-COLOURED KNITTED WORK SWEATER with the sleeves pushed up over a plain cream shirt. She is the same woman in every panel. ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket, or a young man with short dark hair. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

A THREE-PANEL HORIZONTAL STRIP, three panels of equal size in a row, separated by clean cream gutters with no drawn borders or frame lines. ONE consistent world, ONE consistent person and ONE consistent glowing laptop across all three panels, so it reads as a progression.

BEAT ONE. A person sits at a warm wooden desk in an ordinary room. In front of them the whole laptop is a translucent glowing amber holographic object, and INSIDE its screen floats a COMPLICATED, INTERESTING SHAPE with several arms and angles, clearly the thing the job actually needs. The person holds up in one hand a SIMPLE FLAT METAL GAUGE, a plain plate with one plain SQUARE HOLE cut in it. They are holding the gauge up against the complicated shape and it plainly WILL NOT FIT. Their expression is mild frustration.

BEAT TWO. The same desk, the same person, the same glowing laptop. INSIDE the screen the shape has QUIETLY BECOME A PLAIN SQUARE BLOCK, simple and unremarkable, and it slides neatly through the square hole in the gauge the person is holding. The person looks satisfied and untroubled. They are NOT scheming and NOT guilty; they have not noticed anything happened.

BEAT THREE. The same desk. The plain square block now sits FINISHED and solid on the desk in the warm real world beside the laptop. On the wall behind, a SKETCH ON PAPER, pinned up and unfinished, shows the ORIGINAL COMPLICATED SHAPE from beat one, still only a drawing, never made. The person has turned away and is not looking at it. Quiet, a little sad, not dramatic.

TEXT FURNITURE, in the cream margins and NEVER over the artwork. Render these strings EXACTLY and spell every letter correctly:
TITLE BAR above the panels, in caps: 'YOU BUILD WHAT IS EASY TO CHECK'
CAPTION under panel one, in caps: 'THE CHECK DOES NOT FIT'
CAPTION under panel two, in caps: 'THE WORK RESHAPES ITSELF'
CAPTION under panel three, in caps: 'WHAT IT NEEDED, UNMADE'
FOOTER BAR below the panels, in caps: 'THE CHECK IS NOT NEUTRAL. IT IS A HAND ON THE WORK.'
NO other text anywhere. No invented words, no numbers, no signature.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
